_comments.method: Use msiqs, yafu, or mpu.  mpu is the most efficient for under 75 or so digits.
_comments.exec_mpu: The .exe suffix is optional on Windows.
_comments.threads: Threads per job for msiqs and YAFU.  Concurrent serial jobs for mpu.
_comments.min_digits: Fetch exact digit sizes in ascending order through max_digits.
_comments.batch_time: Seconds allowed for starting jobs in a batch. Zero starts jobs until the batch is complete.
_comments.short_download_delay: Minimum seconds from an underfilled sweep to the next sweep. Factoring and submission count toward it.
_comments.sleepseconds: Retry delay for transient RPC failures.
